---
title: "Grading Policy"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
## Notice
This grading policy is **tentative** and subject to change. Final details will be confirmed at the start of the semester.
:::

## Grade Distribution

### Quizzes: 48%
- **16% each** (4 quizzes total)
- **Best 3 out of 4** quizzes count toward final grade
- **No makeup quizzes** for any reason
- Missing a quiz = 0% for that quiz

::: {.callout-note}
## Quiz Schedule
- 2 quizzes during mid-semester period
- 2 quizzes during end-semester period
- Mix of MCQs and subjective questions
- **Closed book** examinations
:::

---

### Assignments: 40%
- **4–5 assignments** throughout the semester
- **Group work** (team size TBA)
- **Variable weights** (8–12% each)
- At least one **implementation project** per assignment

**Assignment Features:**

- PyTorch-based implementations
- Jupyter notebook submissions
- Viva voce evaluation

**Grade Breakdown per Assignment:**

| Component | Weight |
|-----------|--------|
| Code functionality | 50% |
| Understanding (viva) | 25% |
| Code quality | 12.5% |
| Theory concepts | 12.5% |

---

### Attendance: 6%

| Absences | Grade |
|----------|-------|
| ≤ 4      | 6%    |
| 5–6      | 5%    |
| 7–8      | 4%    |
| 9–10     | 1%    |
| > 10     | 0%    |

It is the student's responsibility to ensure attendance is recorded on the biometric system.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Leave Requests
There is no leave request system. If you miss a class, it counts as an absence. No need to inform the instructor or provide medical certificates.

In case a student has to miss 4 or more classes in a row due to an emergency, they can discuss with the instructor for special consideration.
:::

---

### Bonus Points (Up to 6%)

::: {.callout-note}
## Class Participation — Up to 1%
- **0.5% per question** answered in class (max 2 questions)
- At instructor's discretion
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Kaggle Competition — Up to 3%
Subject to availability during the semester.

| Performance | Bonus |
|-------------|-------|
| Participation | 0.5% |
| 50th percentile | 1.0% |
| 75th percentile | 1.5% |
| 90th percentile | 2.0% |
| 95th percentile | 2.5% |
| **Top 3** | **3.0%** |
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Paper Presentation — Up to 2%
Present a recent deep learning paper (from NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, etc.) to the class. Details TBA.
:::
